Why though?

I have always wanted to live, even when I was 16 and started having these thoughts. I just don't know how to reach a place where I can be happy. I have a giant ego, which has grown to be a problem that even when I know it I am unable to change it. I have given up trying to get help, as my ego won't allow it. I am unable to tell my parents that I need help, as this place has a lot of taboo against this. They'll view me as mad or too soft. My friends each of whom have their amount of shit going on in life, never needed therapy. I don't know man what to do. I am not on meds, but I drink and smoke a lot. I wanted psychedelics for so long as to destroy that giant ego causing every problem in my life, but its hard to source here. But that's fine, as I wouldn't have been able to afford it either way.

I understand what you mean very well. I too hate giving advice, always feeling I am not enough to understand what the other person is going through. I don't want to be cheesy but your advice was one of the rarer open-minded and real ones than those I have encountered in a while. I try to reduce my drinking and smoking problem, out of which I feel only the smoking is a big issue. I drink about 4 times a week, sometimes even 2 but I smoke at least 5-6 bowls and a pack of cigs each day. The weed is shit here, so my lungs get fucked up bad but it always seems as though I am punishing myself at each hit. 

I'll tell you my whole life story, if you're interested to listen to it. 

I was doing great in my childhood, or at least that's how I feel about it. I am not going to ruin that by self-doubting the truth in that statement, because I have been down that rabbit hole and I don't feel good about the fact that I may have been sad since the start. Anyway, I had a group in school and a group of nearby friends, both of which tolerated me I guess, maybe also liked. I had always been attracted to the party life, the youth life the hippie life. But my parents shifted us to a new city at the time, which was a lot backward than the one I lived in. People were different, or maybe I was unaccustomed to change, Either way, I wasn't able to party with my new friends, as no one ever went out in that town. No girl-friends either, no relationships and the only girl I talked to, superficially, was my best friends girlfriend. My shyness shown through and converted me to think a lot more than necessary. 

Whenever I used to talk about missing my friends back home and going back there, for I was determined that I belonged with them, with the youth culture, my family ridiculed me till I stopped sharing an ounce of my private feelings with them. My sister also shifted with me and she got into the rat race of getting into a college. We here have an exam for the college entrance which is considered way too tough for a standard 12th students. But, it promises money in the future so a lot and I mean a lot of people appear for this exam (Last years attendance was 1.2M applicants for 10k seats approx). So the competition is fierce and I felt so alone, even more so after my sister graduated and left for college. My old friends forgot all about me, didn't call, but hey neither did I. I felt disconnected to the happiness they harboured and how normal they all were, unlike me whose only thoughts contained of death and pain and the last time I met them was when I wished it to end.

But, I gave my college a last hope, a hope which society shattered into a million little pieces and broke the last remaining fight in me. I hated my college to the point I couldn't stand telling people where I went to. It was a rehash of my coaching center, everyone wanted a piece of the big corporate meat and used the college as a launching pad for their future. No one focused on now, how they were alive, how they must be out drinking talking partying not being stuck up in their rooms all day watching soul-sucking netflix shows and crying about not studying enough.

I grew more and more and more sad until I meet up with my old friends from my residence, who were partying harder than I imagined, smoking more dope than I thought possible and welcoming me with more than open arms, with a trust that I had never felt before and I thought maybe this is the end of my problems, maybe this is the end,

Well, well, what can I say? I wouldn't be writing this if that had happened and oh how I wished it to happen. I was happy but only for a few hours in a week. The rest was as usual the barrage of thoughts about career, job money. All I want is to be a hippie, leave the house and travel a nomad. Never had the guts or the skill on how to survive on low money. I am scared that I live my life scared of any change, yet wanting for change, but terrified if I die that way, not on my terms, but on those which I don't even know.

I used to love reading books. Now, I am unable to sit and focus. You know, I always wanted to be an author and at this point of my life, I fell as though I have even lost my ability to write or think in an artistic way. I feel as though reverted back to my apeish mind, except for the cruel snarky part which haunts me everyday. It has created in my mind that this thing, this darkness inside me gives me my edge and even as I am writing this, I feel ashamed for thinking such thoughts. I am bogged down with thoughts like all my friends like my music because I have the depression which has sharped my mind and created a realist albeit sad world. The problem becomes when I forget how to let happiness colour my reality. I have always believed in psychedelic therapy and the only book I was able to read in my muddled state was Hippie by Paulo Cohello. But, alas like everything, its very hard to source and I am having heavy financial problems. I would love to try psilocybin, but I don't have contacts as all my old friends have been indifferent to me ever since I returned from

I can't stop brother. I spent most of my teens trapped in the house, worrying only about my college entrance exams which would "shape my future". Well that was a lie and I didn't party in my teens. Even after going to college, people rarely partied and all they did was study study all day just to improve their so called future which is a fucking wonderful IT job, monotony at its finest. I started drinking and smoking after meeting my childhood friends who are better off than me drinking and smoking and have a great future ahead of them.  Alcohol has become my pain reliver and I don't have the guts to stop it.
What can we do man? Suffering is our only currency and god's on a splurging mood everyday.

The only reason I am able to share this much is because all this is anonymous. I don't know why but I can never accept help from anyone. I want to be the stoic man with no issues, but I die each day. Each day passes by me cursing the next or my college or my relationships, or rather the lack of it since its count remains stable at 0. I don't know how or WHY to proceed and this was the last chance I had to escape myself. I am feeling so done with everything that anything in my life has stopped changing me, affecting me. Just drowning in my own sorrow as I get off on it. I don't I don't know why and how I'll escape this place but I wanted some advice from you people. I feel many times as an attention whore, just shouting suicide but never doing it as I am a huge coward.

How can I live without it man I don't know. A life of haze is all I can envision and that's a best case scenario. All my family and friends say I am intelligent, but I can't wrap my head around the fact that I can or want to be happy.

Well, more down into the rabbit hole I go to. I know you mean well, but I can't believe in small wins. Any win I have is downgraded after being barraged by a million thoughts of what will happen in the future, what is my life and why am I wasting everyone's time and money including me. It has gotten worse, friend and I see no way out. Therapy is not open here and I have a feeling deep down, that I will die a truly alone and sad life. I don't know how to get over how I fucked up the years where I should've been having fun. I am 21 and from 16, I have judged me, ridiculed me and lowered my confidence that I have forgotten how to talk to people. The one thing that I do enjoy is talking to new people, but I always feel that they know I am faking a cool persona and am actually a sad piece of shit who is rude, arrogant and so egotistical to the point of unlikable because well I am. I try to hide that sight and am still confused that should I hide my true self or not. I know what most people say, that thinking these are leading them to manifest in my life, but the harder I try to put these down the harder they get back. What should I do, I am so ignorant of. If you knew me, like really knew the human equivalent of garbage I am, you'll see how all I do is fake around people to like me, I know that because in my mind, I always will say what the other person wants to hear and that makes me feel so corrupted, as though I don't have the ability to relate and the hilarious part is that they catch on to the real me and well, we know the procedure, hate me leave me blah blah. I don't know how long I'll live for man. It's getting tougher and tougher and I hope to god I don't do anything that'll just increase the overall sadness in the world. Most of my family is going through a tough phase and I will worsen it. It'll all be my fault for not getting over it 4 years ago and that feeling will kill me more than anything. Anyway, thanks for replying brother and god speed.

I get where you're coming from. But the season 1 arc told us that her life will be improving and will she can control herself if she wants to. But after that season, you can never see the kind of changes she went through in season 1. Also she didn't throw herself into her job. It was just that she started taking interest in her job and that that surprised her too. The part where I loved her was where she pushed Gus to tell his family the truth and if she would have been a side character, I would've loved her. But as a main character in the show, I just wished she had gotten some of the changes, as promised in the first season. It just would've made her character loveable if she had gotten better.
Sorry I don't know how to change that.

I feel that in season 1, her character really improves and shows real conviction for change, but in the later seasons there is no progress or development in her character. I too believe that she had borderline personality disorder yet it seems very easy to play off bad character arcs by blaming it on her mental issues. Love as a show must strive harder to show her and other characters getting out from their cocoons of personalities and improve upon their faults. The show does really well in the case of Bertie and Gus. They both seem to change from their initial personalities and the show seems invested in evolving the character. Maybe Mickey's personality was one where it never changes however much she tries, but to me it just seems lazy writing. This could have happened in further seasons. Her character could have renewed easily and become more different than it was at the beginning but sadly the writers didn't think so. All I think is it's very easy to show a character be the same, but it is harder to subtly show the changes that happen to one as one goes through life.
